# The Guardian

> > Global independent news organization providing breaking news, investigative journalism, and opinion coverage on world affairs, UK and US politics, climate crisis, and sport.

The Guardian is owned by the Scott Trust and operates with editorial independence, offering comprehensive coverage of major global events including the Middle East crisis, Iran conflict, and domestic politics in the UK, US, and Australia. The organization also provides content licensing, membership programs, and live events.

## Key Topics

- Breaking news and live updates
- Middle East crisis and Iran conflict
- UK politics and Labour government
- US news and Donald Trump coverage
- Investigative journalism (Paradise Papers, NSA revelations)
- Climate crisis and environmental reporting
- International news (Australia, Europe, Asia-Pacific)
- Editorial independence and Scott Trust ownership
- Content licensing and syndication
- Guardian Patrons membership program
- Military conflicts and geopolitics
- Social justice reporting
- Oil prices and economic news
- Football and sports coverage

## News Coverage

- [Latest news, sport and opinion from the Guardian](https://theguardian.com): Homepage featuring Middle East crisis, Iran-Israel conflict, and global news
- [News | The Guardian](https://theguardian.com/tone/news): News aggregation page with live updates on politics, sports, technology
- [Latest news from around the world | The Guardian](https://theguardian.com/world): World news section covering Africa, Americas, Asia-Pacific, Europe, Middle East
- [US news from the Guardian | The Guardian](https://theguardian.com/us-news): US news coverage including Trump, Congress, FBI, and domestic affairs
- [Latest UK news | The Guardian](https://theguardian.com/uk-news): UK news section covering domestic affairs, defence, and economic updates
- [Politics | The Guardian](https://theguardian.com/politics): UK politics coverage featuring Labour, Parliament, and government policy
- [Latest news, sport and opinion from the Guardian (US)](https://theguardian.com/us): US homepage with Middle East crisis, Iran war, and F1 2026 coverage
- [Latest news, sport and opinion from the Guardian (UK)](https://theguardian.com/uk): UK homepage featuring HMS Dragon deployment, Iran crisis, and F1 2026
- [Main section | News | The Guardian | Todayspaper](https://theguardian.com/theguardian): Today's paper section featuring Starmer-Trump talks on Iran strikes

## Specialized Coverage

- [Environment | The Guardian](https://theguardian.com/uk/environment): Environment section covering climate crisis, wildlife, rewilding, CO2 emissions
- [Football | The Guardian](https://theguardian.com/football): Football coverage with FA Cup, Premier League, Champions League updates
- [Education news, opinion and guides | The Guardian](https://theguardian.com/education): Education section with university rankings, student news, and teaching guides
